name: SmartWoo Product Recommendations
author: Shohanur Islam

sections.description:
By utilizing content-based filtering, SmartWoo intelligently analyzes product attributes such as categories, tags, upsells, and cross-sells, making it possible to recommend the most relevant products to your customers.

Key Features:

  • Personalized Recommendations: Automatically generates product suggestions based on the content and attributes of the currently viewed product.
  • Dynamic Pop-Up Display: Recommendations are shown in a sleek, customizable pop-up on single product pages, grabbing customer attention.
  • Customizable Settings: Offers a range of settings to tweak the recommendation logic, pop-up appearance, and behavior to fit your store’s style.
  • Upsell & Cross-Sell Integration: Perfectly complements existing upsell and cross-sell strategies to maximize revenue.
  • Mobile-Responsive: Fully responsive design ensures the pop-ups look great on all devices, from desktops to mobile phones.
  • Lightweight and Fast: Designed to be lightweight so it doesn’t slow down your website, ensuring a smooth user experience.

Benefits:

  • Increase Average Order Value: Recommend additional products that your customers are likely to purchase, boosting your average order value.
  • Enhance Customer Experience: Tailored product recommendations improve the shopping experience, making it easier for customers to find what they need.
  • Boost Conversion Rates: Targeted suggestions presented at the right time help convert visitors into buyers.

SmartWoo Product Recommendations

Boost your WooCommerce store’s sales and enhance customer experience with SmartWoo Product Recommendations.

Contributing

We welcome contributions to SmartWoo Product Recommendations! If you’d like to contribute, you can fork the repository on GitHub and submit a pull request with your changes. Please make sure to follow the coding standards and include detailed documentation for any new features.

Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions about SmartWoo Product Recommendations, please feel free to open a support ticket on the plugin’s WordPress.org page. Our team will do our best to assist you as quickly as possible.For support or inquiries, please contact us at shuvosa67@gmail.com.

Credits

SmartWoo Product Recommendations was developed by Shohanur Islam. We hope you find this plugin useful in enhancing your WooCommerce store. Thank you for using SmartWoo!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:

    • Upload the SmartWoo-product-recommendations folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the Plugin:

    • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

  3. Configure Settings:

    • Navigate to smartwoo-recommendations in the WooCommerce settings.
    • Customize the recommendation criteria and pop-up design according to your preferences.

  4. Enjoy Personalized Recommendations:

    • Visit your single product pages to see personalized product recommendations in action.
sections.faq:
How does SmartWoo determine which products to recommend?

SmartWoo uses content-based filtering to analyze product attributes such as categories, tags, upsells, and cross-sells related to the current product being viewed. This ensures that the recommended products are relevant to the customer’s interests.

Can I customize the appearance of the pop-up?

Yes, SmartWoo offers various customization options for the pop-up design, allowing you to match it with your store’s branding. You can adjust colors, fonts, and layout settings within the plugin’s settings page.

Is SmartWoo compatible with other WooCommerce plugins?

Yes, SmartWoo is designed to seamlessly integrate with most WooCommerce extensions, including upsell and cross-sell plugins, ensuring smooth functionality across your store.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, SmartWoo is designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring that it doesn’t negatively impact your website’s loading times.

Does SmartWoo work on mobile devices?

Yes, SmartWoo is fully responsive and will display beautifully on all devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
